column1: # Complete-table lines for the 13 spells the official table skips
# Provenance: BLOCK OF ICE/FIRE/ELECTRICITY adapt YT3's ERROR-slot texts
# (files 59/71/80, which name the BLOCKs; ICE 120->180 for YT2's stat);
# MINER'S LIGHT I/II, PARALYZE, FREEZE, CURSE MONSTER reuse YT3's prose
# with YT2's damage numbers (PARALYZE 60->55), assuming YT3's durations;
# BLOCK OF POWER, CREATE FOOD, FORGE, INFINITE ILLUMINATION, SILVER STAKE
# are invented from the YT2 records (w12 damage, classes, AFFECTS/WHEN).
# Durations are engine constants in no record word: unverifiable, assumed.

column4: IN ADDITION TO ITS 260 POINTS OF
DAMAGE, THIS SPELL WILL HOLD A MONSTER
IN A BLOCK OF ELECTRICITY FOR 2
ROUNDS.  IF A MONSTER IS IMMUNE TO
ELECTRICITY, IT WILL NOT BE HELD.
WHILE DOING A DAMAGE OF UP TO 200
POINTS, THIS SPELL WILL ALSO HOLD A
MONSTER IN A BLOCK OF FIRE FOR 2
ROUNDS.  MONSTERS THAT ARE IMMUNE TO
FIRE DAMAGE WILL NOT BE HELD.
THIS SPELL WILL DO A DAMAGE OF 180
POINTS AS IT ENCASES A MONSTER IN A
BLOCK OF ICE.  THIS BLOCK WILL HOLD
FOR 2 ROUNDS.  IF A MONSTER IS IMMUNE
TO COLD DAMAGE IT WILL NOT GET HELD.
WHILE DOING A DAMAGE OF UP TO 310
POINTS, THIS SPELL WILL ALSO HOLD A
MONSTER IN A BLOCK OF POWER FOR 2
ROUNDS.
THIS SPELL WILL CREATE FOOD FOR THE
PARTY OUT OF THIN AIR.
THIS SPELL WILL ALLOW THE CASTER TO
FORGE WEAPONS AND ARMOR FROM RAW
ORE WHEN CAMPED AWAY FROM BATTLE.
THIS SPELL WILL SHROUD THE PARTY IN
LIGHT THAT NEVER FADES.  UNLIKE THE
LESSER LIGHT SPELLS, IT NEEDS NO
RECASTING.
AFFECTIVE ONLY AGAINST UNDEADS, THIS
SPELL WILL DRIVE A SILVER STAKE INTO
AN UNDEAD FOR UP TO 120 POINTS OF
DAMAGE.
THIS SPELL WILL PROVIDE LIGHT THAT
LASTS FOR 2 AND 1\2 HOURS OF GAME
TIME.
THIS LIGHT SPELL WILL LAST FOR 3 AND
1\2 HOURS OF GAME TIME.
THIS SPELL WILL DO A DAMAGE OF 55
POINTS AND ATTEMPT TO PARALYZE A
MONSTER.  AFTER 1 ROUND THE CONDITION
WILL BE BROKEN.
WHILE DOING 70 POINTS OF DAMAGE, THIS
SPELL WILL ATTEMPT TO FREEZE A MONSTER
FOR 1 ROUND.  MONSTERS THAT ARE IMMUNE
TO COLD DAMAGE WON~T BE FROZEN.
THIS SPELL WILL ATTEMPT TO DELIVER A
BLOW OF 80 POINTS, AS WELL AS CURSING
A MONSTER FOR 2 ROUNDS.
WHEN A MONSTER IS CURSED IT CANNOT DO
ITS SPECIAL ATTACK.
